tips.title: Reminders for a healthy pregnancy
tips.note: General information only. Always follow your midwife's advice.
items: Go to all your prenatal checkups, even when you feel well.
Take the iron and folic acid tablets from your health center.
Eat a variety of food, like malunggay and other vegetables, fish, eggs and beans, and drink clean water.
Rest well, and avoid smoking and alcohol.
Bring your card or booklet to every visit.
tips.dangerTitle: Go to the health center or hospital right away if you have:
danger: A severe headache or blurred vision
Swelling of the face or hands
Your baby moving less than usual
Water breaking or strong pains before your due date
